text.en:
Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 25th July 2006 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE 2006 SINGAPORE 41 YEARS OF INDEPENDENCE COMMEMORATIVE COINS TO BE ISSUED ON 25TH JULY 2006

Round
Milled and bearing the words “MONETARY AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE” and lion symbol.
The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2006” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’ clock of the coin.
The coin design features the official 2006 National Day Parade (NDP) logo with the theme “OUR GLOBAL CITY OUR HOME 2006”. The phrase “41 YEARS OF INDEPENDENCE” is at the upper circumference of the coin.

The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2006” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin.
Also depicted is a group of children running hand-in-hand to join in the National Day celebrations.
In the background is the National Stadium which is the venue for this year’s NDP. Hovering above the Stadium is the traditional fly-past of the State Flag.
The denomination is at the lower-left of the coin.
